frozen_prepared_jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One corrected complete portrait card. Image 1 is the exact rejected full-resolution generated PNG editing target; Image 2 is the unchanged original 65x67 card, sole authority for source-visible hair color, pose, clothes and composition; Image 3 supplies user mascot identity only.
Correct ONLY the over-lightened hair tones in Image 1. The exact primary Image 2 upper-lip moustache is DISTINCTLY DARK BROWN/CHARCOAL under the nose. Restore that dark moustache contrast, retaining its source short extent and actual hair texture; remove the bright silver/white moustache top. Restore source DARK GREY/BROWN side/back hair and eyebrow hair with only small natural source highlights, rather than uniform bright silver-white hair. The crown stays bald/receding exactly as in source: do not add scalp hair, extra volume, chin beard, stubble or spectacles. Do not demand microscopic strands; match the clear dark-versus-bright source color areas. Keep existing moustache shape/visible extent and clean chin.
Preserve all already correct parts: exact image-left near-profile head angle, stern closed mascot mouth, compact rounded golden-yellow head and green-ringed black eyes, short broad coherent raised shirt collar/round chin fit with no narrow neck shaft or yellow V, charcoal open-lapel suit, WHITE SHIRT and dark striped tie. No garment-style change, clipping, floating collar or cream belly bib. Keep original lighting, full tilted dark photo frame, OPAQUE grey photographic backing, lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks, source crop and note overlap. All internal body, hair, clothes, note and backing stay opaque; real transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. No added symbols, awards, people, readable writing, labels, watermark or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

scope: Prepared future source-bound art repairs only; no dispatch, returned image or completion claimed
